notes.title: 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860201/d02fabaafc8ec239ec887f3001ce43a93edcba99.png[/img]

Following your EA feedback, we are introducing an exclusive TimeTrial Tournament Mode 🏁
Every month, 4 brand new maps variants to compete against the clock and win Qi-Points to claim your spot on the leaderboard! 🌍
🎮 Download the update and join the race! 🏆 

[b]Patch Note:[/b]
- Added TimeTrial Tournament(thanks Zhoras)
- Added Delta Time display alongside your personal record at the end of each run.(thanks wistorm)
- Fixed a bug causing medals to display in the wrong order (thanks Cocoline)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860201/7435b9b2b87277edaa359f7bf08e3c5fed195a0f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo remains available until full release!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860201/686fc4e3a626daafd77aa0f5d1aebffd22f14a48.png[/img]

Steam is now allowing reviews for demos! To celebrate this new feature, we’ve decided to keep our demo available until the game’s release.
Try out the demo, leave a review, and help us make the game even better before its official launch.

We can’t wait to hear your feedback as you protect the color balance!
